法杖的伤害 × 魔力系数。魔力系数 = 心灵敏感度（最低 0.2，不封顶）；敏感度为 0 时法杖毫无回应。有心灵链接的持有者每次施放增加心灵熵（模组设置），熵满时不能施放；没有心灵链接时伤害只有 70%。穿寒铁护甲或有心智抗性的目标受到的伤害 -25%。
s.en: Staff damage × magic factor. Magic factor = psychic sensitivity (minimum 0.2, uncapped); at 0 sensitivity the staff doesn't respond at all. Holders with a psylink gain neural heat on each cast (mod setting), and can't cast when neural heat is full; without a psylink, damage is only 70%. Targets wearing cold iron armor or with mental resistance take -25% damage.

s.zh: 矮人枪械的伤害 × 魔力系数。魔力系数 = 0.5 + 0.5 × 心灵敏感度 与 心灵敏感度 中较大的一个，不封顶（敏感度 0 也有半伤，100% 以上按敏感度乘）；矮人不足 100% 按 100% 算。不加心灵熵。穿寒铁护甲或有心智抗性的目标受到的伤害 -25%。
s.en: Dwarven firearm damage × magic factor. Magic factor = the larger of 0.5 + 0.5 × psychic sensitivity and psychic sensitivity, uncapped (half damage even at 0 sensitivity, multiplied by sensitivity above 100%); dwarves below 100% count as 100%. Adds no neural heat. Targets wearing cold iron armor or with mental resistance take -25% damage.

s.zh: 魔法枪的伤害 × 魔力系数。魔力系数 = 心灵敏感度，最低 1，不封顶（敏感度低于 100% 不减伤，200% 打 2 倍伤害）。不加心灵熵。
s.en: Magic gun damage × magic factor. Magic factor = psychic sensitivity, minimum 1, uncapped (no damage loss below 100% sensitivity, 200% deals double damage). Adds no neural heat.
